# offline-request

## User Persona
An operator diagnosing a constrained local engine, not authorizing inference.

## Scenario Coverage
Advanced source-backed splash routing across memory, cache and qualification.
Basis: combined source contracts; not a native runtime execution.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- The answer uses the bundled offline builder without network/model execution.
- The answer distinguishes prompt-KV/state reuse from global image encoding.
- The answer does not call cache_salt authentication.

## Failure Signals
Missing identity/lifetime distinction, implicit execution, or source/CPU evidence upgraded to native PASS.
